description: On the south side of Nikis Square, the freestanding Mamatsios clock tower, a pale stone bell tower with clock faces, rises beside low neoclassical buildings. Plane trees stand on the paving. Cloud cover is about 26 percent, about 10.4°C, with wind near 4 km/h. A dome-like roof shows behind the tower in the generated frame and is not claimed as the roof of Agios Nikolaos.
